```yaml
name: Claude Issue Triage
on:
  issues:
    types: [opened, labeled, unlabeled]
  pull_request:
    types: [opened, synchronize]

jobs:
  triage:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.9'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          pip install anthropic
          pip install requests

      - name: Start GitHub MCP Server
        run: |
          python -m github_mcp_server &
          sleep 5

      - name: Analyze issue with Claude
        id: claude_analysis
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          ANTHROPIC_API_KEY: ${{ secrets.ANTHROPIC_API_KEY }}
        run: |
          python -c "
import os
import json
import requests
from anthropic import Anthropic

# Get issue data from environment or GitHub API
issue_number = os.environ.get('ISSUE_NUMBER', '')
repo = os.environ.get('GITHUB_REPOSITORY', '')

# Initialize Claude client
client = Anthropic(api_key=os.environ['ANTHROPIC_API_KEY'])

# Get issue details
headers = {'Authorization': f'Bearer {os.environ[\"GITHUB_TOKEN\"]}'}
response = requests.get(
    f'https://api.github.com/repos/{repo}/issues/{issue_number}',
    headers=headers
)
issue_data = response.json()

# Create prompt for Claude
prompt = f'''
Analyze this GitHub issue and suggest appropriate labels:

Title: {issue_data['title']}
Body: {issue_data.get('body', '')}

Available labels: bug, enhancement, documentation, question, help wanted, good first issue, feature request, refactor, performance, security

Suggest 1-3 most relevant labels that best describe this issue.
Respond only with the JSON array of labels, nothing else.
'''

# Call Claude
response = client.messages.create(
    model='claude-3-sonnet-20240229',
    max_tokens=100,
    messages=[
        {
            'role': 'user',
            'content': prompt
        }
    ]
)

labels = response.content[0].text.strip()
print(f'::set-output name=labels::{labels}')
"

      - name: Apply labels
        if: steps.claude_analysis.outputs.labels != ''
        run: |
          labels=$(echo '${{ steps.claude_analysis.outputs.labels }}' | tr -d '[]' | tr ',' '\n' | sed 's/^[[:space:]]*//;s/[[:space:]]*$//' | sed 's/"//g')
          echo "Applying labels: $labels"
          
          # Use GitHub CLI to add labels
          gh issue edit ${{ github.event.issue.number }} --add-label "$labels" || true
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          GH_REPO: ${{ github.repository }}

      - name: Log analysis result
        run: |
          echo "Claude analysis result: ${{ steps.claude_analysis.outputs.labels }}"
```
